# ENDORSEMENTS
## List of Endorsements
Partial List
ENDORSEMENTS & COMMUNITY SUPPORT
Elizabeth Bracco is proud to have the support of local leaders, business owners, public safety professionals, and community members who believe in a strong future for Gilroy.
Elected & Civic Leaders

Jim & Clorinda Sergi — Business Owners & Community Leaders
Erwin Boggs — Community Leader & Volunteer
#### Chief Denise Turner
I am supporting Elizabeth Bracco for Gilroy City Council. I have personally had an opportunity to work with Elizabeth while she was Interning for the Gilroy Police Department and was assigned to the South County Youth Task Force. Elizabeth contributed in many ways to this program and had great compassion for working with At Risk Youth.
Elizabeth worked well with staff, was reliable and committed to our mission. Since those early days, Elizabeth has completed college, learned a great deal about the legislative process is a local business owner in Gilroy. I can say Elizabeth is 100% comitted to serving the Gilroy community. She cares deeply for Gilroy and has an excellent grasp on the current issues facing the City and California. I believe she will be open-minded with her constituents and bring a positive, common-sense approach to local government. The Bracco family has been committed to public service over the past 2 decades, and Elizabeth wants to continue that tradition.
Please join me in supporting Elizabeth in her campaign efforts.
Ret. Gilroy Chief of Police, Denise (Turner) Sellers
